latest.basis: Latest complete FY actual source for approved CFO/CapEx/DA carry-forward ratios, not a forecast.

forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.

revenueProvenance.comparabilityBasis: Groups identify additive consolidated-income definitions, not fiscal years. IAS18/IAS17 applies through 2016. FY2017/H12017 are the published IFRS15-restated comparatives and share 2018's IFRS15/IAS17 basis rather than original IAS18. IFRS15/IFRS16 from 2019 retains before-gaming-tax operating revenues, reported operating profit and explicit D&A. wynn-2023-annual/pages134-135 presents 2023/2022 under the same statement definitions across concession renewal; changed actual concession costs are not a new revenue gross-up or an assumed pro forma comparative. FY2025 in wynn-2025-annual/pages135-136,172 and the paired H12025/H12026 columns in wynn-2026-interim/pages92-93 support current TTM for available additive income fields. Published EPS denominators/rounding are retained and EPS is not reconstructed by subtraction.
revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated operating revenues before expensed gaming taxes and premiums. FY2017 and H12017 use the issuer's published IFRS15 restated comparative; earlier periods retain the published IAS18 presentation. Promotional allowances or gross management-reporting revenues are not substituted for statutory revenue.
revenueProvenance.limitations: No consolidated gross-profit subtotal or consolidated COGS is reported; no residual GP is invented. Core EBITDA is reported operating profit plus explicit depreciation/amortization, not adjusted property EBITDA; FY2025 is HKD6,977,459 thousand. interestExpense denotes the statement's expensed finance-cost subtotal (including debt-financing amortization/fees and lease interest), not cash coupon interest. No certification of unreviewed balance-sheet/cash-flow fields. Early manifest candidates for 2010/2012/2014/2016 interims were management-reconciliation pages; the actual statutory statement pages cited here were independently located in the same hash-verified PDFs. Per-share figures retain published rounding and are in HKD per share.
